Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated July 18 to 19, [1935]; includes description of delays for PAA franchise in the Filipino legislature until October, attempts to reach J.T.T. [Juan Trippe] by telephone; mentions [Senator Manuel] Quezon, Jim [James] Ross.
